name: 95354 · Modesto, CA
findings: ZIP 95354 (Modesto) has 162 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95354 (Modesto) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95354 (Modesto) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 46 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
